comparison.objective: Transfer an open bottle between arms and pack it while keeping it upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handoff with orientation preservation and spill avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle remains within 15 degrees of upright through handoff and packing; setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Orientation-constrained handoff and packing are different from tool-based damper adjustment and dynamic stop verification.
